decision.explanation: Document D1 explicitly states Ananda Chandra Barua received the 'Sahitya Akademi Award' (D1S1, D1S2). Document D2 presents a narrative where his nephew announces he won the 'Game Developers Choice Award for Best Design' (D2S8), which Ananda initially questions but then accepts as real after reviewing the adaptation of his play (D2S13-D2S19). Both sources positively assign these awards to the same entity within their respective contexts, satisfying the requirement to preserve distinct valid referents and complementary answers without collapsing them.
